Submitting a problem report sends the device model, OS and app versions, connection method, network-interface information, error state, and this app’s logs. It does not include sites you visit or network packet contents. Do not enter passwords or other sensitive information.

Open FastCat on the computer, enable USB debugging, and allow this computer to debug the phone. If it still cannot connect, reconnect the USB cable so the computer can restore forwarding. FastCat will keep retrying.

Check the USB or Wi-Fi link between the devices, and make sure the peer device is awake with FastCat running. The app will keep retrying.

Make sure the computer is online. Disable conflicting proxies or VPNs, then try again.
Allow FastCat to use the VPN and the permissions needed by this connection. Wired connections also need USB device access. If denied, reconnect and approve the system prompt.
The connection protocols do not match. Update FastCat on the phone and its peer device.
FastCat versions on the two devices are incompatible
Restart FastCat on the computer and check whether a firewall or security app is blocking it.

FastCat is still retrying. Make sure the computer app is open and the USB cable works, then report the problem so we can investigate.

USB disconnected. Check whether the cable is loose or unplugged.

"Wired internet requires the system USB tethering switch.
Tap “Open settings,” enable USB tethering, and return to FastCat. The wired connection will start automatically."

"The USB cable was reconnected.
Android turns off USB tethering whenever the cable is unplugged, so it must be enabled again after reconnecting. Apps cannot enable it automatically because of system restrictions.
Tap “Open settings,” enable USB tethering, and return to FastCat to reconnect automatically."
Could not open the settings page. Go to Settings → Network/Connections → Tethering → USB tethering.
Permission not granted. The VPN will not start.

"FastCat uses Android VpnService to forward your phone’s network traffic through your computer. While connected, the app accesses and forwards destination addresses and network packets in real time. This is required for the core connectivity feature.
Traffic is not stored, sold, used for advertising or profiling, or shared with third parties. The VPN runs only after you start a connection, and a persistent notification shows its status. You can disconnect at any time.
The system VPN permission is requested only after you agree. If you decline, the VPN will not start."
